title: SOLAS XII regulation titles taught wrongly on QB4_A#q20 (Reg 5, Reg 9, Reg 14) and QB3_A#q1 (Reg 9 as double side skin)
candidate_claim: Raised by the September 2026 independent adjudication review (SEP-0094 fix): QB4_A#q20 titles XII/14 and XII/9 differently from QB3_A#q8 and from the consolidated Chapter XII text.
rationale: Under the Chapter XII text adopted by MSC.170(79) (in force 1 Jul 2006) Reg 9 is the requirement for bulk carriers not capable of complying with Reg 4.3 due to the design configuration of their holds, and Reg 14 is 'Restrictions from sailing with any hold empty'. The two table rows and the version stamp are corrected; nothing else on the card is changed. The card's MSC.520(106) amendment claims were not re-verified in this pass and are not touched. The independent technical review of 2026-09-23 then found the same Reg 9 error in three places on QB3_A#q1 - the first card in the new Q19's examiner chain - and the QB4_A Reg 5 row giving the stability standard (which is Reg 4); both are corrected here so the note's claim of agreement is true.
note: Separate record for the same reason as CORR-COGSA2025-20260923.
authority: Consolidated SOLAS Chapter XII text (post-MSC.170(79)) and the IMO bulk carrier safety page, read 2026-09-23. Registered as SRC-SOLAS-XII-CONSOLIDATED.
propagation: QB3_A#q1 (60-second answer, bullet, reg-box) and QB4_A#q20 (table rows Reg 5, 9, 14) corrected; QB3_A#q8 already carries the correct Reg 14 title; QB3_A#q19 (new, H7-001) states it. Swept all 86 files for 'Reg 9' / 'Regulation 9' with 'XII' or 'double' context on 2026-09-23: no other card attributes double side skin to XII/9.

invariants.new_cards_note: The five new cards belong to batch_h7_manifest.json; both share baseline 8e291db.

review.independent_review: adjudication-level independent review 2026-09-23 confirmed the card text as written; the correction itself is pending Founder review
